## Agent of Chaos Water Nymph (CR 9)

**XP 6,400)**  

CN Medium fey (aquatic, chaotic)  
**Init** +7; **Senses** low-light vision; Perception +12  
**Aura** blinding beauty (30 ft., DC 23) chaos field (80 ft.)  



**Defense**


**AC** 27, touch 27, flat-footed 19 (+9 deflection, +7 Dex, +1 dodge)  
**hp** 104 (8d6+56)  
**Fort** +18, **Ref** +22, **Will** +16  
**DR** 10/cold iron; **Immune** magic  
**Weaknesses** vulnerability to law  



**Offense**


**Speed** 30 ft., swim 20 ft.  
**Melee** mwk dagger +13 (1d4+2/19–20)  
**Special Attacks** chaos curse, stunning glance infusion of chaos, warpwave (DC 21)  
**Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 8th)  

1/day—dimension door, lesser confusion (16)  
3/day—blink, entropic shield, freedom of movement  

**Spells Prepared** (CL 7th)  

4th—summon nature’s ally IV  
3rd—cure moderate wounds, cresting waves (2 DC 15)  
2nd—barkskin, flame blade (2), resist energy  
1st—charm animal (DC 13), endure elements, entangle (DC 13), obscuring mist, produce flame  
0—detect magic, guidance, light, stabilize  



**Tactics**


**Before Combat** Due to her magic immunity, this creature does not cast ability-increasing spells upon herself, instead using them as boon gifts for her allies. She is known to suppress her chaos field and disguise her form to hide her blinding beauty until she is forced into battle (or until a true seeing spell reveals her true form and the onlooker must save).  

**During Combat** If forced into combat she releases her chaos field and reverts to her true form as free actions and then sets about casting cresting wave, using her dagger only against mages.  

**Morale** She never fights to the death; though she is a gambler, when she does retreat she flees into the water if possible.  



**Statistics**


**Str** 14, **Dex** 25, **Con** 24, **Int** 18, **Wis** 15, **Cha** 29  
**Base Atk** +4; **CMB** +11; **CMD** 29  
**Feats** [Weapon Finesse](../../rules/feats/weapon-finesse.md), Combat Casting, [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md), Quicken Spell-Like Ability (confusion, lesser)B, [Weapon Focus (dagger)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md)  
*House rules: Dodge is part of Dodgility; Agile Maneuvers and Weapon Finesse are one feat, Weapon Finesse; in their place: Weapon Focus (dagger).*  
**Skills** Diplomacy +20, Escape Artist +18, Handle Animal +17, Heal +9, Knowledge (nature) +15, Perception +12, Sense Motive +12, Stealth +18, Swim +21, Use Magic Device +20.  
**Languages** Aklo, Common, Sylvan  
**SQ** amphibious, change shape (polymorph, 3/day), inspiration, unearthly grace, wild empathy +23  



**Special Abilities**



**Chaos Field (Su)** Any supernatural, spell or spell-like ability within 10 feet of an agent of chaos automatically causes a mishap. Continuous magical effects such as those created by magic items trigger only once per chaos field and if the spell is negated it is only suppressed for 1d4+1 rounds. Supernatural effects are considered to have an effective caster level equal to the creature’s HD and its effective spell level is equal to half the creature’s HD.
